description: PV Terms publishes a shared vocabulary for photovoltaic-system modelling and data analysis. The DuraMAT repository README calls it a work in progress and links formatted documentation, with contribution routes for corrections. Users apply its definitions when naming PV equipment, operating conditions or performance measures so datasets and calculations use consistent terms. The output is a documented nomenclature, not production measurements or a simulation engine. Geographic coverage is global because the terms are not limited to a country, although local electrical standards may use different wording. GitHub metadata states BSD-3-Clause licensing. A limitation is that a vocabulary does not resolve calibration, unit conversion or device-identity errors on its own. It can help combine PV plant data for benchmarking and electricity-system simulations. The related OSeMOSYS catalogue model runs scenarios, not defining PV terminology. No documentation build or dataset was downloaded.
